44:3.text: [(i.e. night of Al-Qadr, Sûrah No. 97) in the month of Ramadân - the 9th month of the Islâmic calendar]
[mankind that Our Torment will reach those who disbelieve in Our Oneness of Lordship and in Our Oneness of worship]

44:4.text: is decreed every matter of ordainments.

44:5.text: (or this Qur’ân or the Decree of every matter)
from Us. Verily, We are ever sending

44:6.text: a Mercy from your Lord. Verily, He is the All-Hearer, the All-Knower.

44:7.text: The Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, if you

44:8.text: (none has the right to be worshipped but He)
. It is He Who gives life and causes death - your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers.

44:9.text: Nay! They play about in doubt.

44:10.text: Then wait you for the Day when the sky will bring forth a visible smoke,

44:11.text: Covering the people: this is a painful torment.

44:12.text: : "Our Lord! Remove the torment from us, really we shall become believers!"

44:13.text: How can there be for them an admonition
(at the time when the torment has reached them)
, when a Messenger explaining things clearly has already come to them.

44:14.text: Then they had turned away from him
(Messenger Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم)

44:15.text: Verily, We shall remove the torment for a while. Verily you will revert

44:16.text: On the Day when We shall seize you with the greatest seizure

44:17.text: And indeed We tried before them Fir‘aun’s
people, when there came to them a noble Messenger

44:18.text: Saying: "Deliver to me the slaves of Allâh
. Verily, I am to you a Messenger worthy of all trust.
